race.comment: AEOLIAN (9) has been thereabouts in three runs in Australia, perhaps just unsuited staying at 2000m last time in what was a steadily run race. Now up to 2400m suits perfectly and this looks very winnable from a good draw. GO DADDY (1) is stuck on 1 win from 22 but is coming off a second to progressive stayer Nearco Frod who has won again since. That was in a stronger race hence the weight jump, a repeat goes close. CUSTOMER SERVICE (12) is very consistent but struggling to win. He gave a solid sight two back then took a sit latest and ran well again. Williams goes on from an ideal draw, he'll be hard to beat again. STOP THE ROCK (3) looks primed for 2400m now off some solid form over shorter this time in, consider. PRESSURISED (10) proved too strong from the front last time and has to be greatly respected again.
